name: markup-lsp
description: Language intelligence for Claude Code in config and markup files: YAML, TOML, JSON, HTML, CSS, XML and Markdown, through yaml-language-server, taplo, vscode-langservers-extracted, lemminx and marksman. Hook-free: it installs nothing and expects the servers on PATH; its servers.nix is the package list a Nix config imports to put them there.
